Full analytic proof, not finite tests, supports the unlimited-m limit.

value.rationale: A natural graph-dependent binary Markov chain has a complete parity/topology phase distinction: exact odd-unicyclic TV universality versus a continuum of nontrivial even-unicyclic likelihood-ratio and chi-square profiles, with a sharp m log m cutoff window for the correct periodic reference law. The precise alpha parameter records the macroscopic cycle fraction and is useful for contrasting graph families beyond routine eigenvalue estimates.
